metadata.title: AptToSell Follow-Up Event Registry 2026
metadata.description: Event-level registry covering 103 first observed follow-up apartment supply events in South Korea in 2026. Each row links an AptToSell project ID to the first follow-up date, official follow-up notice ID, canonical official source URL, and evidence grade. All 103 rows have numeric notice IDs and canonical official source links; 13 rows are PRIMARY_VERIFIED and 90 are ID_CORROBORATED_SECONDARY. Follow-up supply should not be interpreted as a contract-failure or unsold-rate estimate.
metadata.notes: Public release file: apttosell-followup-event-registry-public-v0.2.csv. Records: 103. Verification: 13 PRIMARY_VERIFIED; 90 ID_CORROBORATED_SECONDARY. License: CC BY 4.0.
